steps.name: create-branch
steps.description: Create task/t0080_bedb_mobo_v3_dendritic_spike_nsga2 branch from main and initialize step tracker.

steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify t0024, t0069, t0076, t0078 are completed.

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create the mandatory task folder structure.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Review existing papers on dendritic spikes (Sivyer 2013, Oesch 2005), Mg-block NMDA in DSGCs, and NSGA-II benchmarking on neural compartmental models.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Search for pymoo NSGA-II API conventions, recent dendritic-spike NEURON models, and any newer Werginz / Kole AIS Nav measurements.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review t0078 BoTorch harness, t0069 Bed A AIS implementation, t0076 BO baseline, NMDA MOD files, and Nav1.6/NaP MOD implementations.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Synthesize research, design the v3 substrate, NSGA-II port, hard biological bounds, regression check, and answer asset; estimate Vast.ai compute and write plan.md.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Provision a Vast.ai 64-core CPU instance (EPYC 7B13 class) and prepare the Python+NEURON+pymoo environment.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Build the dendritic-spike-augmented Bed B v3 library; run pre-launch t0076 iter-424 substrate regression check; launch NSGA-II via pymoo; collect results.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Destroy the Vast.ai instance and finalize cost tracking.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Out-of-the-box analysis on the v3 Pareto front and dendritic-spike contribution.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json, costs.json, remote_machines_used.json, and Pareto-front / hypervolume images.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Compare the v3 Pareto front to RivlinEtzion 2012, deRosenroll 2026, Park 2014, Sivyer 2010, Oesch 2005, Trenholm 2013, Werginz 2024, Kole 2008, and the t0078 baseline.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Generate follow-up suggestions for the next brainstorm.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all verificators, capture sessions, set task status to completed, and prepare for PR.
